query:
SELECT d.version
          FROM item_artifact_link l
          JOIN document d ON d.id = l.to_document_id
         WHERE l.from_item_id = $1 AND l.kind = $2 AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND d.project_id = $3 AND d.item_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4::uuid AND d.kind = $5
           AND d.id <> $6
         ORDER BY d.version
         LIMIT 1
